posts.trend: 'Rent a garba partner' posts spark cyber safety concerns ahead of Navratri
posts.context: Indian families use festival gatherings as high-intensity validation boards for single millennials.
posts.angle: Renting a fake partner to escape parental pressure only exposes them to corporate scrutiny from uncles.
slides: Beta, Navratri pe akele ja rahe ho?

Umar nikli ja rahi hai.
Agli baar dadi ke liye bahu lani hai.
Sharma ji ka beta toh settle ho gaya.

You rented a partner just to stop the questions.

They asked her what her CTC is.
posts.caption: Whose family has already prepared the spreadsheet of prospective biodatas? 📋
